deckIntent: An editorial journey through climate tech's pivotal moment — intimate, atmospheric cards that feel like pages from a premium sustainability magazine. Photography-driven storytelling with restraint and emotional weight, treating climate innovation as both urgent and beautiful.

cards.cardInstructions: Title card with full-bleed hero image behind text. Atmospheric shot of wind turbines at golden hour, dramatic sky, silhouetted against warm light. DISPLAY heading: 'Climate Tech 2025' overlaid bottom-left. Minimal subtitle beneath. Label: 'The Moment' in accent color above title. Warm cream background shows through overlay.

Dark olive background, no image. Smart-layout with 3 solidBoxes showcasing key trend categories. Label: 'Three Forces' above H1. Accent color highlights on emotional keywords in each box. Clean, structured content on colored surface for readability contrast after hero image.

Behind image: close-up of solar panels with morning dew, macro photography, shallow depth of field, natural lighting. H1 about energy storage breakthrough overlaid. Single sentence of body text. Label: 'Innovation' above heading. Warm cream background through overlay.

Deep brown background, no image. Two-column asymmetric layout with challenges content. Label: 'Reality Check' in accent color. Structured text with accent highlights on key challenge words. Creates breathing space and information density after atmospheric image card.

Breather card. Behind image: hands holding seedling in cupped palms, soft natural light, intimate composition, shallow focus. DISPLAY text only: 'Opportunity.' overlaid center. Dark olive background shows through overlay. Emotional pause in the narrative arc.

Warm cream background, no image. Smart-layout featuring investment opportunities and market data. Label: 'The Numbers' above H1. 2-3 solidBoxes with key statistics, accent color on monetary figures and percentages. Structured information card following breather.

Behind image: wide shot of offshore wind farm emerging from morning mist, cinematic composition, cool tones shifting to warm. H1 about scaling solutions overlaid bottom-right. Label: '2025 Vision' above heading. Dark olive background through overlay.

Closing card with full-bleed hero image behind text. Atmospheric shot of city skyline with green rooftops and solar installations, golden hour lighting, hopeful mood. DISPLAY heading: 'The Future' overlaid center. Single call-to-action sentence beneath. Warm cream background shows through overlay. Echoes opening card's visual language.
